children: There is a high chance that Polish interest rates will stay stable until the end of the year, central banker Przemyslaw Litwiniuk told broadcaster TVN24 on Sunday.

"On the basis of currently available data, I believe there is a high likelihood of rates remaining at their current level until the end of the year," he said. He added that the Monetary Policy Council would take action if forecasts released in November showed elevated inflation could persist for a long period.
